title: A binding whose dimension reference matches nothing is rejected by the engine, not by the SDK.
why: behavioural spec 'given': rejecting a reference that matches no dimension is the engine's (variant semantics spec §6.5) — an SDK does not compute variant spaces, so it cannot know. The DSL accepts the call, and the failure arrives from the engine as 'interaction-invalid' when the interaction is added.

interaction.description: a binding on a field the shape does not have
